title: Pristionchus Whole Genome Sequence Analysis
author: erick.rios.
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bu83nzyn

steps.title: Prepare Workspace and Sequence Files
steps.instruction: Create a workspace folder and download sequence files in compressed .fq.gz format. Ensure each genome consists of at least two files from paired-end reads.

substeps.instruction: Decompress files using the terminal (e.g., `gunzip -d filename`).
If BGI files or multiple reads are present, concatenate them into two files using: `cat reads1.fq reads2.fq .... readsN.fq > combined_reads.fq`.

steps.title: Install Required Bioinformatics Tools
steps.instruction: Install BWA, samtools, and bcftools. These are Linux/Mac based tools.

substeps.instruction: For Mac users: Run `brew install bwa`, `brew install samtools`, and `brew install bcftools` in the terminal.

For Windows 10 users: Install 'ubuntu 20.04 LTS' from the Microsoft Store, open the command shell, type `bash`, and run `sudo apt-get install bwa`, `sudo apt-get install samtools`, and `sudo apt-get install bcftools`.

steps.title: Configure System Permissions
steps.instruction: If the system requires admin or root permissions to run bash scripts, use `sudo -i`, `sudo -s`, or `chmod -R 777 ./`.

steps.title: Gather Reference Sequences and Scripts
steps.instruction: Download or move the following reference sequences and scripts into the workspace folder:

substeps.instruction: El Paco Genome (Representative wild-type genome of P. pacificus)
El_Paco_V3_gene_annotations_bcftools.gff3
SRR546092 (PS1843, Washington WILD mapping strain)
ERR4367042 (nhr-40 suppressor, SUP, pooled mapping panel)
ERR4367073 (nhr-40 suppressor mutant line tu515)
ERR4367101 (nhr-40 mutant line tu505)
count_allele_frequencies.pl
Automation_v1_3.sh

steps.title: Prepare the Automation Script
steps.instruction: Prepare the Automation_v1_3.sh script for execution in the bash terminal.

substeps.instruction: Copy the script code into a text document and save it.
If the file is saved with Windows (CRLF) line endings, convert it to Unix (LF) using `fromdos FILENAME.txt` (install via `sudo apt install tofrodos` if necessary).
Change the file extension from .txt to .sh.

steps.title: Execute the Analysis Pipeline
steps.instruction: Run the automation script in the bash terminal and respond to the prompts to define the analysis scope and input files.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to the script location and run `./Automation_v1_3.sh`.
Specify whether to perform the ENTIRE protocol, candidate regions, or candidate mutations.
Provide the representative genome file and decide if it needs indexing.
Provide suppressor reads (if applicable) and mutant reads.
Provide the annotation file for candidate mutations.
Provide wild read and map read files for candidate regions.
Provide the 'Source Code 1' perl script for candidate regions.
Specify the number of CPU threads for alignments (Minimum: 1; Max: 5).

steps.title: Analyze Results
steps.instruction: Process the output files generated by the script.

substeps.instruction: Import 'mapping_data.txt' into Rstudio for candidate region analysis.
Import 'Candidate_Mut.txt' (containing missense, stop_gained, synonymous, and INDEL results) into Excel or a spreadsheet application using tab-delineated format.

steps.title: Identify Large Indels via IGV
steps.instruction: Use the Integrative Genomics Viewer (IGV) to identify insertions and deletions >1 kb, as these are not captured by the mutation workflow.

substeps.instruction: Load the El Paco Genome and El_Paco_V3_gene_annotations_bcftools.gff3 into IGV.
Load the relevant .bam file (e.g., Ppa-hsd-2(csu60)).
Load the .bai index file (generate using `samtools index csu60.bam` if not present).

steps.title: Compare Multiple Mutant Genomes
steps.instruction: Compare candidate mutation lists from multiple alleles using the provided Perl scripts (`extract_genes.pl` and `compare_lists.pl`).

substeps.instruction: Extract genes from VCF files: `perl extract_genes.pl Mut1_variants_annotated_all.vcf > set1.txt` and `perl extract_genes.pl Mut2_variants_annotated_all.vcf > set2.txt`.
Compare the resulting lists: `perl compare_lists.pl set1.txt set2.txt`.
